entity.name: Vinayak Raj Sharma
entity.description: Engineer working on GPS-denied autonomous UAV navigation and related embedded software. The project is intended to publish reusable navigation software and documentation for the open-source community as development and licensing are finalized.

projects.name: GPS-Denied UAV Navigation
projects.description: An intended open-source software project exploring navigation for unmanned aerial vehicles when GPS is unavailable or unreliable. Planned work includes software, integration notes, and documentation for sensor-based motion estimation and autonomous navigation. The repository, initial public release, and open-source license must be published before this manifest is submitted as a live project listing.

channels.description: Please contact vinayakrajsharma21@gmail.com for payment details before making a transfer.

plans.name: Tranche 1 — Core Open-Source Development
plans.description: First tranche: USD 25,000 to establish and publish the initial open-source software baseline. Planned work includes repository setup, core navigation-software modules, reproducible development and testing instructions, technical documentation, and an initial public release under a clearly documented open-source license. Deliverables and spending will be documented publicly as appropriate.

plans.name: Tranche 2 — Integration, Testing and Validation
plans.description: Second tranche: an additional USD 25,000, intended to follow completion and review of the first-tranche deliverables. Planned work includes software integration notes, expanded automated and simulation tests, hardware-integration documentation, validation reports, bug fixes, and community-facing documentation. This brings the proposed total project support to USD 50,000 across two milestone-based tranches; the second tranche is conditional on progress and funding approval.
